statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The patient has a history suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I48.0
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
